title: UI: Unify shared topbar, Settings, and Game/Restart controls across Editor, Commons, Benchmark, and SoakLab
goal: Unify the full application topbar, Settings modal, and Game/Restart controls across all standalone pages

sections.what: Consolidate the index.html topbar and Settings modal with shared_topbar.html across all four HTML entrypoints.
sections.why: Standalone pages (/commons, /bench, /soak) currently only have Commit/Clock/nav links and bounce to / for Settings or Game/Restart actions.
sections.how: Promote shared_topbar.html and shared-topbar.ts to include the full Game menu, Restart, and a shared Settings modal fragment so index.html and all sub-pages share one header implementation.
sections.verify: pytest tests/test_commons.py -q and npm run build:ts

acceptance.text: One shared Jinja topbar partial and controller powers /, /commons, /bench, and /soak
Settings modal and Restart/Game menu actions work in-place on /commons, /bench, and /soak without bouncing back to /
All existing index.html topbar controls (Commit, Clock, Spectator, Game menu, CommandPalette, Settings, Help, Narration) remain intact

custom.browser_ui: Every top-level page (World, Commons, Benchmark, SoakLab) renders the identical topbar with working Commit, Clock, Game menu, Restart, and in-place Settings modal.
